_comment: How the skill outputs. Output is CHAT-ONLY: print the validated raw JSON-LD ({"@context":…,"@graph":[…]}) in chat with NO <script> wrapper — this is the paste-ready form for Storyblok's Structured Data Markup field, which adds the <script> tags itself. Leaving the <script type="application/ld+json">…</script> wrapper in breaks that field, so mention the wrapper only as an optional note for a direct <head> embed. The skill does NOT save to Google Drive and does NOT write or update any tracking log / Sheet — the old Drive-save + recreate-the-whole-log workaround was removed (it was a token sink and left duplicate sheets behind). The only field still used from this file is richResultsTestUrlPattern.
